dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time flies so fast! Before you know it, Lantern Rite's almost here again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The people of Liyue must've already started preparing for their most important festival of the year, right? Hopefully, Paimon will be able to check out tons of great food again this year!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's go to Liyue Harbor and see what's up!
